description: Read a domain's Link in Bio page (a single page of links, the kind people put in an Instagram or TikTok profile): its public `url` (the domain itself, or `<domain-with-dashes>.l.ink` for the free page most .com domains registered at Porkbun come with), `plan` and `features` (what the plan allows), `profile`, `links` in display order with their `id`s, `socials`, `appearance` and `settings`. Call it before editing. LINKINBIO_NOT_FOUND means there is no page: offer create_link_in_bio (free) or create_hosting with a PIXIELINKS sku (paid).

domain.description: Domain whose Link in Bio page this is, e.g. `example.com`.

name: get_link_in_bio
title: Get Link In Bio
